findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GeneralLinear/ScalarExtension.lean:129` defines `mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms` via `Module.End.baseChangeHom` and `cancelBaseChange`; lines 149 and 176 give the same pure-tensor and comparison-square behavior as `mapValueGL_coe` plus `mapValue_comp_rTensor`. `rg` also shows numerous existing consumers under Representation, Tangent, and Kostant root-subgroup files.
findings.fix: Use or generalize `GeneralLinear.mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms` for the tensor-automorphism construction, or make the new generic implementation canonical and migrate all existing consumers while deleting the old API.
findings.issue: `Module.End.mapValueGL` is a parallel implementation of the existing `GeneralLinear.mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms`; both base-change automorphisms of `A ⊗[R] M` along an algebra map and have the same pure-tensor/transport characterization.

summary: The new general-linear-group base-change API duplicates TauCeti’s existing canonical scalar-extension automorphism API instead of consolidating it.
